verdict.rationale: Fly.io markets fast-booting, hardware-isolated VMs/Sprites that let teams spin up many independent environments cheaply and scale to thousands (fly-io-docs-7, fly-io-docs-14, fly-io-docs-10), which directly supports the story. However, extensive community reports describe frequent outages, flaky deploys, unreliable Postgres machines, and unresponsive support that undermine confidence in using this for simultaneous team-wide shipping (fly-io-comm-2, fly-io-comm-5, fly-io-comm-7, fly-io-comm-19).
